name: Living Together Not Married
overview: Scripture clearly defines the sacredness of marriage as a covenant where a man and woman become one flesh, as established in Genesis 2:24. Living together outside of this covenant is inconsistent with God's design, as passages like Hebrews 13:4 affirm that marriage is honorable and the sexual relationship within it undefiled, while those engaging in sexual immorality face divine judgment. The New Testament further underscores the importance of faithfulness and purity, warning against works of the flesh such as fornication and uncleanness (Galatians 5:19; Colossians 3:5), and Jesus’ instruction in John 4:16 highlights the expectation of marital commitment. Ultimately, God’s love, demonstrated through Christ (John 3:16), calls believers to live in obedience to His standards, honoring marriage as He intended.
